observations_considered: Generation 8A repaired execution so that all 16 raw triads are run, and rule-aware symmetry is analysis after the fact. That repair stands.
The Generation 8A information figures are ordinary plug-in mutual information from finite tables, without a bias correction, a permutation reference, or a kernel replacement.
R00, R03, and R07 do not read the triad in their pair-event rule. Their exact initial-context and full-mask current-context information on pair observables is a structural zero.

The baseline first-destination plug-in is about 0.031 to 0.043 nats, and the largest uniform-raw cell is R03 star at about 0.0702 nats. R03 is one of those structural zeros, so that cell cannot be read as a routing effect until it is calibrated.
Checkpoint pair-class plug-in values stay near 0.12 nats through pair event 512. Persistence of the plug-in number is not persistence of information when the exact value on the controls must be zero.

Current-context plug-in information given the full pair mask is about 0.018 nats on the controls and about 0.030 to 0.036 nats on triad-conditioned rules. The first figure matches the scale of a finite-table bias.
reason: The state space has 1024 states and the transition law is known, so the information in the law can be calculated. Permutation calibrates the estimator that Generation 8A actually reported. New trajectories would repeat the same estimator.

observations_considered: 336 Generation 8A plug-in cells reproduce. Maximum absolute gap 2.810e-16.

First-destination permutation-null means lie between 0.03024 and 0.03127 nats. Exact-kernel MI is at the 1e-10 floor for R00, R03, and R07, and for every path cell. The largest exact value is R05 star and triangle at 2.025e-5 nats. R03 star plug-in 0.07021 sits at null percentile 99.6 with exact value at the floor.

Checkpoint plug-in class MI from epoch 2 onward has median about 0.12 to 0.14 nats, beside a null median near 0.132. Exact class MI is at most 0.02798 nats (R06 path, checkpoint 1) and is at the floor from checkpoint 64 through 512.

At checkpoint 1 on star and triangle the exact class information is edge count. At checkpoint 1 on path, R01 and R06 carry a larger shape-given-edge term. Both coordinates, and the labelled mask, are at the floor by checkpoint 64.
Exact dense-minus-sparse context range over epochs 1..512 is at the floor for R00, R03, and R07 and at most 0.001925 on R06. Per-triad edge-count values agree across sources to about 1e-15.

Exact full-mask slot CMI is at the floor for R00, R03, and R07 under balanced, A0 empirical-source, and stationary weightings. Conditioned balanced values are 0.009749 to 0.023368. Stationary values are 0.012025 to 0.016895. Class conditioning retains 0.44 to 0.71 of the stationary slot information.
reason: B0 separated plug-in bias from the transition law. The persistent plug-in figures sit on the permutation null. A small exact local dependence remains where the rule reads the triad, and a small transient initial-context effect remains in the first pair events and in the 512-epoch occupancy average. Neither asks for a new trajectory census before a mechanism reading of the kernel.
